long_description:
Indianapolis is getting a New Year's Eve celebration with a full Bollywood heart. Midwest ShowMakerz and Lush Dekaur present Bollywood New Year's Eve 2027 on Thursday, December 31, 2026, from 8 PM to 2 AM at Garnet Waterfront Hotel in Indianapolis. DJ Prabh leads the music with Bollywood hits, Bhangra energy and party anthems, while MC Sam and MC Deb host the night and build up to a midnight countdown. Decor partner Lush Dekaur sets the look for the evening. A theater will be open for kids during the event. Indian food and drinks will be available for purchase, parking is free, and security will be on site all night. Tickets are sold only on the official website, midwestshowmakerz.com, and are not sold through any other platform. Event updates: https://www.facebook.com/events/3892257711095876/ For questions, email SW5mbyB8IG1pZHdlc3RzaG93bWFrZXJ6ICEgY29t or call (929) 600-1700.
